Q5932.reason: In intermittent high-intensity work, catecholamine-driven hepatic glucose output often exceeds uptake, so blood glucose commonly rises about 1–3 mM rather than falling.

Q5939.reason: Net H+ comes from ATP hydrolysis when glycolysis is the main ATP source; PCr breakdown and pyruvate-to-lactate both consume protons.

Q5944.reason: A lawful assignee of a land purchaser stands in the buyer’s shoes and may obtain specific performance; zoning appreciation, notice of refusal, and dealer status do not defeat that remedy.
